id: # The disasters of calendar-and-turn.md, "Disasters" (manual p.9). One row for each disaster that the calendar can start in a city.
# months: the months when the disaster can start on day 1 (documented). The other numbers are assumed (Q-162): the spec gives the effects but no amounts.
# chance_percent: the chance for each city at each month in the list. turns: the length; 0 = no length: the disaster acts at once (harvest) or ends by a rule (bandits).
# start_order_loss: public order at the start. turn_order_loss: public order each turn. grain_percent: locusts take this percent of each grain payment; the harvest adds it to the grain of the season.
# soldier_percent: soldiers lost each turn. facility_damage: durability that one built facility of facility_target (an effect name, any, or none) loses each turn.
# low_order_only: yes if the disaster starts only below order.bandit_threshold. ends_at_order: yes if it stops when public order reaches order.bandit_threshold.

# skill_block: the skill that stops the disaster in the city (skills.md: 風水 #98). skill_chance: the skill that changes the chance (祈願 #99 more often, 威壓 #96 less often); skill_chance_percent: the chance with that skill. 0 = no skill. A skill is its number in skills.md.
